basic_details.job_title: ACEM Paid Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Advanced Centre for Energetic Materials (ACEM), a DRDO establishment under the Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India, has invited applications for paid internships of 06 months for pursuing engineering and science UG/PG students. There are 5 indicative positions in four branches (Chemical Engineering, Mechanical / Armament Engineering etc., AI&ML / Data Science etc., and Chemistry). Applications go by speed post to The General Manager, ACEM, Ambe Hills, Ojhar, Nashik-422207, latest by 11 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

qualification.details: *The number of positions is indicative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of the establishment. Duration of internship / project work for every branch is 06 months at ACEM, Nasik - 422207. | Category: students pursuing Under-Graduate / Post Graduate courses (B.E/B.Tech Final Year or 1st / IInd Year M.Sc/ M.Tech). Minimum qualification (all branches): pursuing Engineering Degree (7th/8th semester) or M.Sc/ M.Tech (1st / IInd year), full time course in the respective discipline from a recognised Indian University/Institute. Marks: good academic track record with 85% marks or 8.5 on a scale of 10 or above (copy to be enclosed), first class with distinction, from AICTE/UGC approved universities. Minimum 8.5 CGPA or above continuously maintained in all previous semesters. Age limit: Below 28 Years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. The Principal/Director of the institution should provide the request letter for highly deserving meritorious students only. A brief bio-data of fewer than 300 words highlighting achievements is required; awards or professional membership, if any, are to be mentioned. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each branch.

selection_process: The selection procedure will be decided by the Selection Committee on the basis of Merit / Interview / Interaction. No communication will be undertaken for rejected candidates.

Only shortlisted students will be notified about the joining procedures and the undertaking forms and indemnity bond to be filled by them and by the head of the institution. The management reserves the right to change the vacancy positions or selection criteria at any point during the selection process without assigning any reason. The notice does not describe the interview or interaction (date
venue or marks) in more detail.
important_instructions: Incomplete or erroneous applications, and applications received after the due date, will be rejected. No further communication will be entertained. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible. Selected candidates can obtain lunch, tea and snacks at subsidised rates at the ACEM canteen. The stipend applies only if the student has good academic performance and completes a minimum of 15 working days per month of physical attendance at ACEM. The stipend is paid into the student's bank account in two instalments. The first instalment is paid after 03 months of training. If a student leaves before completing the programme, the Certificate of Completion will not be issued. No payment will be made if a student does not complete a tenure of 03 months. The completion certificate is awarded on successful completion of the internship, which includes clearing evaluation of project work, submission of the project report and other formalities. ACEM / DRDO has no obligation to offer employment to interns, and an intern cannot claim a right to employment on completing the internship. The college's request letter states that the college has no objection to the student joining, will relieve the student, accepts to give the indemnity form when required by ACEM, and assures that the student will complete the full tenure.

content_sections.heading: About ACEM
content_sections.text: ACEM (Advanced Centre for Energetic Materials) is described in the notice as a state-of-the-art composite propellant processing facility of DRDO, located at Ambe Hill, Ojhar, Nasik. It is dedicated to delivering world class rocket motors and meeting the requirements of various strategic missile programs of the country.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by speed post addressed to: The General Manager, Advanced Centre for Energetic Materials (ACEM), Ambe Hills, Ojhar, Nashik-422207 (Kind Attn.: To HRD Division). On top of the envelope, write "Application for Paid Internship" and the Branch Code No (CE, ME, AI &DS or CHEM), for ease in segregation of applications. Use the "Format for Application for Paid Internship Scheme" printed in the notice. It carries a passport size photo (4.5 x 3.5cm), and asks for name, date of birth, Aadhar No, college details, discipline, branch code, degree with semester or year, CGPA on a scale of 10, achievements, languages known, addresses, contact numbers, email ID and a checklist of enclosures. The notice also prints a request letter format, to be printed on college letterhead and signed by the Principal / Director of the college with office seal. It requests an internship from 1 January 2027 to 30 June 2027 and records the college's undertakings (see Important Instructions). The notice gives no email address for applications.

Marks: good academic track record with 85% marks or 8.5 on a scale of 10 or above (copy to be enclosed), first class with distinction, from AICTE/UGC approved universities. Minimum 8.5 CGPA or above continuously maintained in all previous semesters. Age limit: Below 28 Years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. The Principal/Director of the institution should provide the request letter for highly deserving meritorious students only. A brief bio-data of fewer than 300 words highlighting achievements is required; awards or professional membership, if any, are to be mentioned. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each branch.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice for the application: Application in the prescribed format with a passport size photo (4.5 x 3.5cm) affixed. Reference letter issued by the Principal / Director of the college or institute (to be mandatorily attached). UG / PG marksheet reflecting CGPA. Copy of latest Aadhar card. Brief bio-data under 300 words highlighting achievements. Documents for selected students at the time of joining (not for the application): No Objection Certificate (NOC) in original on college letterhead, stating that the student will be relieved for internship training at ACEM and will be present for a minimum of 15 working days in a month. Police verification: the acknowledgement received from the police station, to be submitted at joining. Undertaking for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and an undertaking to follow IT rules and regulations applicable for the Ministry of Defence and its amendments. Bank details for transfer of the stipend. Medical fitness certificate from an authorised medical practitioner holding at least an MBBS degree. Aadhar card (original) with college ID card, 03 passport size photographs, and all previous semesters' marksheets in original. Originals are returned immediately after verification. Any other documents, if required, will be communicated at the time of selection/joining. The college provides the indemnity form as and when ACEM requires it.

faq.question: Q1. How many positions are there in the ACEM paid internship?
faq.answer: There are 05 indicative positions: Chemical Engineering 01, Mechanical / Armament Engineering etc. 01, AI&ML / Data Science etc. 01 and Chemistry 02. The number may increase or decrease at the establishment's discretion.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ACEM internship?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ACEM internship?
faq.answer: Candidates must be pursuing an engineering degree (7th/8th semester) or M.Sc/M.Tech (1st/IInd year), full time, in the respective discipline from a recognised Indian University/Institute, with 85% marks or 8.5 on a scale of 10 or above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend?
